dialogues.speaker: Arapas
dialogues.text: The soup using Vanarana water, tastes almost the same with that using "Living Spring"...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They are both nice water, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Arapas
dialogues.text: #Well said, Nara {NICKNAME}. Nara {NICKNAME}, so smart, as if you have been drinking Vanarana water all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Arapas
dialogues.text: #This time, soup using Vanarana water for Nara {NICKNAME}. Next time, I will find nicer water.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The taste is key...

dialogues.speaker: Arapas
dialogues.text: The taste... Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Arapas
dialogues.text: #I heard that follow the running river and you find a big area of water with strong scent. Nara {NICKNAME} wants soup with that water?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Arapas
dialogues.text: #Bye, hope Nara {NICKNAME} will always have delicious water to drink.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds much too strong...

dialogues.speaker: Arapas
dialogues.text: #Really? Nara {NICKNAME}, so strange. You said water with scent is delicious, but you hate water with too much scent.

dialogues.speaker: Arapas
dialogues.text: Guess clear water is better for soup.

dialogues.speaker: Arapas
dialogues.text: The soup at Festival Utsava... Very "shocking." So I am going to look for nicer water in the north.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The north?

dialogues.speaker: Arapas
dialogues.text: I heard that there is Vana's river source's source in the north. The water there is clearer than moonlight. A pot filled with that water looks as if is holding nothing but air.

dialogues.speaker: Arapas
dialogues.text: #Soup cooked with that water, will make Nara {NICKNAME} and Aranara happy. I am sure.

dialogues.speaker: Arapas
dialogues.text: So, in my "special cooking training," I will follow the direction that tree shadows point to, and find nicer water than Vanarana water.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Arapas
dialogues.text: #Hope to see Nara {NICKNAME} in the north.

dialogues.speaker: Arapas
dialogues.text: Vanarana water is nice. But I heard, in the north, there is sweeter and clearer water...
